Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 31, "heading": "I\nDU DANGER DE CONFIER SON SECRET À UNE CHÈVRE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u031-b0126", "target": "Тем временем добрая дама с досадой поднялась. — Ну вот что, цыганка, если ни ты, ни твоя коза не станете нам плясать, что вы тут делаете?", "source_sha256": "f79e7a7019a9303bcb9574ffb0c56afd7b78182b0c149e56b1324b76db15c730", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u031-b0126", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "0c9ce4b8e119b1ed5967918782b976f498cdd815082f370e499ce181750a5781"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u031-b0127", "target": "Цыганка, не отвечая, медленно направилась к двери. Но чем ближе она подходила, тем медленнее становился её шаг. Непреодолимый магнит словно удерживал её. Вдруг она обратила на Феба глаза, полные слёз, и остановилась.", "source_sha256": "84f0bdbf093132ca5142a2ad1c1375878d69a5bddae26178f579a55d118d8690", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u031-b0127", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "325d1e374acb680773c91d9720d3fa592e7f04832c6957ba02912a36cf981995"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 7, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u031-b0128", "text": "«Vrai Dieu! s'écria le capitaine, on ne s'en va pas ainsi. Revenez, et dansez-nous quelque chose. À propos, belle d'amour, comment vous appelez-vous?", "sha256": "6bde6ff99b69a69749b6fd30bfdcf2bb615575ae80abaccb50b8521d0f93edd0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1725], "source_xml_sha256": "a9893b959b3c1184c451871903222cb60c761316f2232acbfcf1e5731433db7f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0129", "text": "—La Esmeralda», dit la danseuse sans le quitter du regard.", "sha256": "c54c0e25e265a1427f2e62b66898c4504a190d70650a35e593710445dfc98648", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1726], "source_xml_sha256": "f2a6cb378eed9e4bda33a61257bd9b1e8c9b895e531a8d1e8e1693e9c4b4f8b8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0130", "text": "À ce nom étrange, un fou rire éclata parmi les jeunes filles.", "sha256": "b2c548e039c6b8ad0c38f0b6657a6be7eae22b7e10a21e6b45081b9e2ecbe4f7", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1727], "source_xml_sha256": "a6a48155c2f69b04aad6f0b8734e933499d7970ad0fd966e4d76b4bfc43ff965", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0131", "text": "«Voilà, dit Diane, un terrible nom pour une demoiselle!", "sha256": "9e21489aa02d5346d32149c6df43a36528d2f987b8028f3b62b395ef79f918e5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1728], "source_xml_sha256": "37e3a9e0792655edbe326282e60176e805abb1b7da71f3c0c58b741d1d272dcc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0132", "text": "—Vous voyez bien, reprit Amelotte, que c'est une charmeresse.", "sha256": "64321548374c42f8ee49156069b12232bbd064fdc4305240d1fa97ad2f110c97", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1729], "source_xml_sha256": "4f43fa1e6c4303f072cbb27806d41f192b2aef8ad860c76b7d9d937c6634dc1e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0133", "text": "—Ma chère, s'écria solennellement dame Aloïse, vos parents ne vous ont pas pêché ce nom-là dans le bénitier du baptême.»", "sha256": "ce70204e554180a5b98c4c6cc8d740152da7b6a8be582b0488120e9511a1c8c9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1730], "source_xml_sha256": "2f15f498a3851cb298944fcefa3ddf5d76dadd391f94430f8e7a4156e17fcb4f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0134", "text": "Cependant, depuis quelques minutes, sans qu'on fît attention à elle, Bérangère avait attiré la chèvre dans un coin de la chambre avec un massepain. En un instant, elles avaient été toutes deux bonnes amies. La curieuse enfant avait détaché le sachet suspendu au cou de la chèvre, l'avait ouvert, et avait vidé sur la natte ce qu'il contenait. C'était un alphabet dont chaque lettre était inscrite séparément sur une petite tablette de buis. À peine ces joujoux furent-ils étalés sur la natte que l'enfant vit avec surprise la chèvre, dont c'était là sans doute un des [[I]]miracles[[/I]], tirer certaines lettres avec sa patte d'or et les disposer, en les poussant doucement, dans un ordre particulier. Au bout d'un instant, cela fit un mot que la chèvre semblait exercée à écrire, tant elle hésita peu à le former, et Bérangère s'écria tout à coup en joignant les mains avec admiration:", "sha256": "4d3b94c5dd8855183cac2b35f1097021da7e2fc95f9d43e976ee99008a124df2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1731], "source_xml_sha256": "3e908885c67a551b28293db00aa58393b1308100c3e8e9630b08960e4d43168d", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0135", "text": "«Marraine Fleur-de-Lys, voyez donc ce que la chèvre vient de faire!»", "sha256": "dd81ca63145352cfe06bf613c8a44b365c357696385c824c52e0845c9296cf89", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1732], "source_xml_sha256": "3b355a442780299f8fa52952b9507993482ad547008eaa7afc6ec0210b8e1f0f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0136", "text": "Fleur-de-Lys accourut et tressaillit. Les lettres disposées sur le plancher formaient ce mot:", "sha256": "c033294f6c632bcc7ffc0ffb5a601ff2665793d14e679bc1148132a780d17086", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1733], "source_xml_sha256": "1deff9fe69e0a01b8e1b53a6e4e69423eb0d1c0c0127773449fc4b6351535eb3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0137", "text": "[[I]]PHŒBUS.[[/I]]", "sha256": "868d299b03deb2a234114e670735fc587d8778738ffcab46407f0c0fabad7b87", "role": "verse_group", "tag": "div", "source_physical_indices": [1734], "source_xml_sha256": "7b00beda064457a39d650d178300c27a94c8b719597f89765f70455969843796", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_lines": ["[[I]]PHŒBUS.[[/I]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0138", "text": "«C'est la chèvre qui a écrit cela? demanda-t-elle d'une voix altérée.", "sha256": "294f7ac112169bb1d6af8047b8561044bf72ae6cdb188915b71f3ddb4a335be8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1735], "source_xml_sha256": "06e02be41cc048cac1ee074b7ecbc5756c7391f69b86b6cab581436fb74cd549", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0139", "text": "—Oui, marraine», répondit Bérangère.", "sha256": "31b4a8718c57dd2110d9e984ee840714803ea6b5ed4e6986ddd24f914d881e41", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1736], "source_xml_sha256": "8d037c51a7c9c9c92c4a812c3ab02761836d3540a2d5129229f29c0a7116d343", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0140", "text": "Il était impossible d'en douter; l'enfant ne savait pas écrire.", "sha256": "50594202a418f9d71a92f752a13bc643e1e5af3f5a72a66b9dc15f7d674c53af", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1737], "source_xml_sha256": "bb1e56778fea6d218b8c5d7cb8380b7650538828547d81114f0951f432b841ba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0141", "text": "«Voilà le secret!» pensa Fleur-de-Lys.", "sha256": "0fcf517e21b55df9aaeebb6ee02047a2eda0b736d0eb14958933ff81c2b5719f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1738], "source_xml_sha256": "91280bdd9cc07319172f0145a783354e42d56f0f150b77f76bc4a373afae2b4f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0142", "text": "Cependant, au cri de l'enfant, tout le monde était accouru, et la mère, et les jeunes filles, et la bohémienne, et l'officier.", "sha256": "a6f3dc41de0336fb8d57f240702ac5da41cf29c756611aa6b3ae108598bc8b0e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1739], "source_xml_sha256": "d72d2983b810aec4179814f6f3cb4b1a43952ddea70328e6b2689bbeb6a4af37", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0143", "text": "La bohémienne vit la sottise que venait de faire la chèvre. Elle devint rouge, puis pâle, et se mit à trembler comme une coupable devant le capitaine, qui la regardait avec un sourire de satisfaction et d'étonnement.", "sha256": "6eb8c85c245d0144c8c03e76363183a571e7b8c38b3bc27117ec80a58c3f34cf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1740], "source_xml_sha256": "5e11b320e0f2bce8e0c75b2234528f40e5bf19a81ff1029904bf760a3816e252", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0144", "text": "«[[I]]Phoebus[[/I]]! chuchotaient les jeunes filles stupéfaites, c'est le nom du capitaine!", "sha256": "9a0ff9613bb46affbcdcb64bbdcec30aa4f730355c347de061bcdbcf69e9a614", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1741], "source_xml_sha256": "2da23ac4689078d9fb85eea2ab2e255eb22e8b26b2b09a46d864e9666826bfa6", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0145", "text": "—Vous avez une merveilleuse mémoire!» dit Fleur-de-Lys à la bohémienne pétrifiée. Puis éclatant en sanglots: «Oh! balbutia-t-elle douloureusement en se cachant le visage de ses deux belles mains, c'est une magicienne!» Et elle entendait une voix plus amère encore lui dire au fond du cœur: «C'est une rivale!»", "sha256": "7dc4ab77c5824b554c246e9313aa89bd5f901110d17d5352610ab0fb5b589b81", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1742], "source_xml_sha256": "b1072a63d9579f64cd73af71d388a2bc5f2daa844dd4af343c690e9e9696e2cb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0146", "text": "Elle tomba évanouie.", "sha256": "c056bc40096b1460bd0f60effdee29fd13d845260d14690a9619ef63fa03fe6c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1743], "source_xml_sha256": "bb84d0254ab092bd4f79037767fafc630d3a96656193b60c8207c32ecc6f0118", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0147", "text": "«Ma fille! ma fille! cria la mère effrayée. Va-t'en, bohémienne de l'enfer!»", "sha256": "65b52323679c9eab9466d14b4ddecc048c9ea739a78cc7e7f018b86e088384a6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1744], "source_xml_sha256": "554320f588dcf7cb4b74bb29bfe65217eeb4d97b9ba31adcea415eef4731e545", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0148", "text": "La Esmeralda ramassa en un clin d'œil les malencontreuses lettres, fit signe à Djali, et sortit par une porte, tandis qu'on emportait Fleur-de-Lys par l'autre.", "sha256": "4990063e181822f222bf68e4958c2332b2c5b4da0086909b2644f19510afc57e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1745], "source_xml_sha256": "e6b41e49092d8a4bcef04ec3252ae07e6139882d601d46a0d9cce6087e86c9b9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u031-b0149", "text": "Le capitaine Phoebus, resté seul, hésita un moment entre les deux portes; puis il suivit la bohémienne.", "sha256": "2eef062022faf127b98dd9f833219ba1e9d1507f83e89a55390d0cfa313a09f6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1746], "source_xml_sha256": "a49d1de4bb4ffcd36b50682846f02cba6d96db484af0cfeef462dc8c2048ea3b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
